narrative.overview: 34cats uses a calm, immediately understandable product language: neutral surfaces, direct language, generous breathing room, and familiar controls. The interface disappears behind the choice of useful apps.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral canvas with crisp white working surfaces.
One workhorse sans-serif family and compact, readable hierarchy.
Rounded controls and panels with restrained borders.
Orange reserved for brand emphasis and meaningful links.
Quiet motion limited to direct interaction feedback.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange appears sparingly. Primary actions may use neutral ink when that produces a calmer and clearer hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a border and a large shadow on the same ordinary card.

dos: Do make every app understandable by name, outcome, status, and action.
Do keep controls familiar and copy literal.
Do preserve visible focus, 44px targets, and responsive reading order.
Do let whitespace separate distinct ideas.
donts: Don't copy ChatGPT or Claude branding, assets, or proprietary layouts.
Don't reintroduce the concourse metaphor, split-flap lettering, or status lamps.
Don't use orange on every border, heading, and button.
Don't invent prices, balances, usage numbers, or customer proof.
